question.text:
What is $X$ in the following reaction?
$\mathrm{CO}+2 \mathrm{H}_2 \xrightarrow{x} \mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{OH}$

solution.text: The given reaction is for the industrial preparation methanol from a mixture of carbon monoxide and hydrogen . In the reaction the gaseous mixture is subjected to 200 atmosphere and then passed over heated catalyst mixture of ZnO and $\mathrm{Cr}_2 \mathrm{O}_3$ kept at $573-673 \mathrm{~K}$. This reaction results the formation of methanol vopours which are then condensed to liquid state.
